notes.title: Don't worry, we are alive and kicking! Pricing Updates and more
One Year Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
April 29th will mark my one year Steam Anniversary, so this week enjoy my games at their lowest prices yet! 

Don't be confused by the percentages, most of the games had permanent price reductions a few weeks ago, so while the discounts may not seem as high as they were during the last sale, the end result is still cheaper. 

And due to technical difficulties, the art collection for Legend of Zuri will start it's sale a day later than the rest of the collection...

Thanks again, and stay tuned for what's coming in the future.

notes.title: Queen's Coast Casino - Uncut Steam Launch

That's right! The fully uncut and uncensored version of Queen's Coast Casino will arrive on Steam soon! Gamble away your virtual cash or spend it on other activities to fight off any potential cabin fever you may have. Enjoy a fantasy vacation at the greatest resort from the safety of your home.
